articles.title: Kraken parent Payward plans to offer tokenized IPO access as investors await blockbuster debuts
articles.snippet: Payward aims to give retail investors access to IPO shares at the offering price through tokenized equities.

articles.title: Trezor says your crypto is safe after Ledger audit exposes a hardware flaw
articles.snippet: The flaw affects only one of the wallet's multiple security layers and would require physical access, specialized equipment and advanced expertise to exploit.

articles.title: DeFi won't win over big banks until it fixes its hacking problem, executives say
articles.snippet: Lenders are particularly interested in blockchain's back-office applications, but security failures are blocking wider adoption.

articles.title: Crypto firms face July 1 EU cutoff as MiCA grace period ends
articles.snippet: The ESMA says crypto companies without MiCA authorization must stop serving EU clients from July 1, even if their licence applications remain under review.

articles.title: Binance to end NFT support on exchange, shift service to wallet
articles.snippet: Binance exchange said it will move NFT support from its exchange to its non-custodial wallet and offered users 30 days to migrate their NFTs.
